title: Contracted powers of a Zariski torsor form an extension
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and G an abelian sheaf on the small Zariski site X_Zar [def-sc-zariski-site]. For a G-torsor T [def-sc-gm-torsor], the sheaf coproduct E = coproduct over n in Z of the contracted powers T^{\otimes n} (iterated contracted products as in [lem-sc-torsor-h1]), with T^{\otimes 0}=G and negative powers formed from the inverse torsor, has an abelian-sheaf structure by concatenation. The exponent map E \to Z_X is a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] 0 \to G \to E \to Z_X \to 0, and its fibre over 1 is canonically T.
